steps.title: How this test works
steps.body: The TCF Canada speaking test has three tasks: a short talk about yourself, a role-play and an opinion. Here you practise useful sentences out loud and choosing the right reply. At A2 you handle everyday situations: appointments, hobbies and simple requests.

steps.fr: Je voudrais prendre rendez-vous avec le docteur, s'il vous plaît.
steps.en: I would like to make an appointment with the doctor, please.

steps.fr: Le week-end, j'aime marcher et voir mes amis.
steps.en: At the weekend I like to walk and see my friends.
steps.tip: Replace the activities with your own.

steps.fr: Pardon, pouvez-vous répéter, s'il vous plaît ?
steps.tip: Ask this when you did not understand. It is always allowed.

steps.prompt: The examiner asks the question below. Which answer fits?
options: Le week-end, je joue au soccer avec mes amis.
steps.explain: The question asks what you do at the weekend.
steps.promptFr: Qu'est-ce que vous faites le week-end ?

steps.prompt: You phone a restaurant. What do you say first?
options: Bonjour, je voudrais réserver une table pour deux personnes.
steps.explain: You greet and say what you need.
